caption: The drawing depicts a folded rectangular textile laying flat on a plain background. The textile features a repeating geometric pattern of interlocking circles and petal shapes in navy blue and off-white. Each segment of the pattern consists of a navy blue circular area with four white petal shapes radiating from the center, forming a grid of circles and petals. The navy blue portions are decorated with small white dots, while the white portions have fine, faint line detailing. There is a slight shadow beneath the textile, suggesting it is raised from the surface. Below the textile, handwritten text reads “size 87" by 68"” and “Mary Bonner.” The overall background color is a light beige or cream, with no additional objects or details visible.
